description: Angular component for managing dynamic form properties, including form control setup, validation, import/export, and drag-and-drop reordering.

classes.name: DynamicFormPropertiesComponent
classes.description: Angular component for dynamic form property management, including validation, import/export, and drag-and-drop reordering.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription for validation and property management.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form controls based on provided property array.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form, checks for unique property IDs, and sets error messages.

methods.name: propertyIdUnique
methods.description: Checks if a property ID is unique within the form.

methods.name: propertiesFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of properties.

methods.name: trackByProperty
methods.description: Track function for property controls in ngFor.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a property at a specified index.

methods.name: addProperty
methods.description: Adds a new default property to the form.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports current properties to a file.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports properties from a file and updates the form.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all properties after user confirmation.

methods.name: preparePropertiesFormArray
methods.description: Creates a form array from a list of properties.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves and filters the current list of properties.
